caption:
These are real NASA astronauts manually flying Orion, a deep-space capsule designed for Moon missions, through space. After separating from the rocket's upper stage, the crew took the controls themselves and ran a proximity operations test: practicing the exact moves they would use to dock with another spacecraft or handle an emergency. The whole idea is to prove the crew can fly the thing by hand before they go any further from Earth.
